title: Black-ground acanthus mantling, one face only (viewer's left half labelled; the right half is a free mirror)

components.name: Upright frond beside the crest
components.desc: Rises from behind the wreath and leans out, its tip hooking up and to the left. Lobes come off the outer (left) edge only, each one curving up toward the tip.

components.name: Hanging hook leaf
components.desc: A short stem bends out and down and finishes in a hook that turns back in. Its lobes sit on the outside of the bend, which makes the bend read as fuller.

components.name: Outer palmate frond
components.desc: The biggest single leaf. One long, gently S-shaped midrib runs up and out; broad lobes fan off both sides and get smaller toward the tip; the lower lobes droop and their tips curl inward.

components.name: Small hook leaf
components.desc: A small leaf filling the gap between frond 3 and the middle frond: same gesture at a smaller scale, which is how the design fills space without crowding.

components.name: Middle frond from the helm
components.desc: Leaves the helm almost level and runs out to the left. Lobes curl up along its top edge and droop along its bottom edge; the tips nearest the helm are the largest.

components.name: Small lower leaf
components.desc: A detached small leaf below the middle frond, pointing back up toward it; it balances the hanging lobes above.

components.name: Flame leaf beside the shield
components.desc: Rises from behind the collar like a flame: a broad body that sweeps up and curls over to a sharp tip that points back the way it came.

components.name: Lower double curl
components.desc: Below the flame the cloth splits into two curls that turn away from each other, like the two halves of a heart.

components.name: Drop
components.desc: A last small tear-shaped lobe, separated from the rest, closing the composition at the bottom.

key: midrib of each frond, root to tip
notes: What makes these shapes natural: every frond is one smooth midrib (a C or a gentle S, never a zigzag); lobes sit on the outside of each bend and get smaller toward the tip; every lobe tip curves toward the frond's own tip; and fronds of very different sizes nest into one another's gaps.
Fills: red only (the gold drops and black ground are left out). Outlines traced from the painting and fitted with smooth curves; numbering and midribs are hand-placed.
